<meta>Page number: ᠬᠣᠶᠠᠷ ᠳᠡᠭᠡᠳᠦ ᠬᠣᠶᠠᠷ / 第二卷上二 (Volume Two, Upper Part, Folio Two). Header: ᠶᠡᠬᠡ ᠡᠷᠳᠡᠨᠢ ᠳᠠᠪᠬᠤᠷᠯᠠᠭᠰᠠᠨ / 大寶積經 (The Great Heap of Jewels Sutra / Maharatnakuta Sutra).</meta>
<note>Ornamental rectangular double border with floral and foliate scrollwork printed in red ink enclosing the text block and marginal panels.</note>
<margin>The Great Heap of Jewels <note>original: "ᠶᠡᠬᠡ ᠡᠷᠳᠡᠨᠢ ᠳᠠᠪᠬᠤᠷᠯᠠᠭᠰᠠᠨ"</note>, Volume Two, Upper Part</margin>

<meta>continues from previous page: concluding the fourth chapter of the Maharatnakuta Sutra and beginning the fifth chapter</meta>
From the division of the Great Vehicle <term>sutra</term> <gloss>discourse</gloss> entitled The Noble Manifestation of the Splendor of Light <note>original: "ᠬᠤᠲᠤᠭ ᠲᠤ ᠄ ᠭᠡᠷᠡᠯ ᠦᠨ ᠴᠣᠭ ᠢ ᠦᠵᠡᠭᠦᠯᠦᠭᠴᠢ"; Sanskrit: Samantamukha-parivarta or Prabhasa-sri</note>, the Section of Supplication <note>original: "ᠥᠴᠢᠬᠦ ᠢᠢᠨ ᠠᠶᠢᠮᠠᠭ"</note>.
This is the fifth chapter, the section entitled The Manifestation of the Radiance of the Buddha <note>original: "ᠪᠤᠷᠬᠠᠨ ᠤ ᠭᠡᠭᠡᠨ ᠢ ᠦᠵᠡᠭᠦᠯᠦᠭᠰᠡᠨ ᠨᠡᠷᠡᠲᠦ ᠵᠦᠢᠯ"</note>.

In the language of India <note>Sanskrit</note>: <term>Ārya Mahāratnakūṭa Mahāyāna Sūtra</term> <gloss>The Noble Great Heap of Jewels Great Vehicle Discourse</gloss> <note>original: "ᠠᠷᠢᠶᠠ ᠷᠠᠳᠨᠠ ᱠᠦᠳᠠ ᠮᠠᠬᠠ ᠶᠠᠨᠠ ᠰᠦᠳᠷᠠ"</note>.

In the language of Tibet: From the Noble Great Heap of Jewels Dharma Discourse in One Hundred Thousand Chapters, that which is called the Chapter of Supplication, the fifth chapter <note>original: "འཕགས་ པ་ དཀོན་ མཆོག་ བརྩེགས་ པ་ ཆེན་ པོའི་ ᠁ ཆོས་ ཀྱི་ རྣམ་ གྲངས་ ལེའུ་ སྟོང་ ཕྲག་ བརྒྱ་ པ་ ལས་ ཞུས་ པའི་ ལེའུ་ ཞེས་ བྱ་ བ་ སྟེ་ ལེའུ་ ལྔ་ པའོ"</note>.

In the language of Mongolia: From the Noble Great Heap of Jewels <note>original: "ᠬᠤᠲᠤᠭ ᠲᠤ ᠶᠡᠬᠡ ᠡᠷᠳᠡᠨᠢ ᠳᠠᠪᠬᠤᠷᠯᠠᠭᠰᠠᠨ"</note>, the Dharma Discourse of the Great Vehicle in One Hundred Thousand Chapters, the fifth chapter, called the Chapter of Supplication <note>original: "ᠥᠴᠢᠭᠰᠡᠨ ᠪᠦᠯᠦᠭ"</note>.

Homage to all the Buddhas and <term>Bodhisattvas</term> <gloss>awakening beings</gloss>!

<margin>The Great Heap of Jewels Sutra, Volume Two, Upper Part, Folio Two <note>original: "大寶積經第二卷上二"</note></margin>

<summary>This folio from a multilingual Buddhist woodblock print of the Maharatnakuta Sutra (The Great Heap of Jewels Sutra) marks the conclusion of the fourth chapter and the opening of the fifth chapter, titled the Chapter of Supplication. It provides the formal title of the scripture in Sanskrit, Tibetan, and Mongolian, followed by a traditional salutation to all Buddhas and Bodhisattvas.</summary>
